name: hindsight
description: Cross-session self-improvement loop: mines session and subagent transcripts for recurring friction and proposes CLAUDE.md rules, skill/plugin ideas, and defects against the plugin artifact that was running — applied only on approval.

cc_skill_log.title: Skill-use log (CC_SKILL_LOG)
cc_skill_log.description: Log each skill invocation to a machine-local ledger under ~/.claude/hindsight: on or off. The environment variable CC_SKILL_LOG overrides this.
